events.headline: UAE announced a total trade and financial embargo on Iran following a call from Trump; Iran's FM called it a diversion amid US debt/fiscal strain. Comes after the US-Iran 60-day truce deadline lapsed Aug 17 with no deal, raising Gulf tension risk
Brent crude rose to roughly $93-95/bbl (up over 1.5% on the day) on Gulf supply risk tied to escalating Iran tensions

US Treasury announced it will more than double debt buybacks (from $2B to at least $4B) across 10/20/30-year maturities; 30-year yield fell over 10bps to ~5.18% and 10-year fell to ~4.64%, easing bond-market stress after last week's 19-year yield high

Chip selloff continued: Intel and AMD fell about 4% (AMD dropped below the $500 level) even as bond yields eased broadly, while Nvidia was roughly unchanged; underlying AI accelerator/data-center demand still seen as robust

Moderna soared 105% and BioNTech rose about 19% after positive Phase 3 trial results (Moderna/Merck) for a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine combined with Keytruda in melanoma patients; biotech ETFs XBI/IBB up over 4%
